photos.desc: Suncus etruscus , the smallest mammal by weight of the world. Portrait over hand for comparison.
Eurasian Pygmy Shrew ( Sorex minutus ). Misidentified as etruscan shrew ( Suncus etruscus , which has larger ears, longer hairs on the tail and different tail shape [1] ).
